Just four minutes into the game, Ferran Jutgla found the back of the net with a clinical right-footed finish, expertly set up by Hugo Alvarez . Levante ’s resilience shone through as they mounted a fierce comeback. Despite ten minutes of stoppage time and several dangerous corners from Swedberg and Mingueza , the Levante defense held firm.
